title: Lord Of War
description: A 3D recreation of Nicolas Cage’s iconic speech, made in Blender. Currently working on the whole intro sequence showing the life of a bullet.

title: Monkey Business
description: First person arena shooter about NFT-making monkeys going apeshit. It won the People's Award choice.

title: Bachelor Thesis
description: Indoor navigation using AR and Immersal SDK in Unity for Android and iOS.

title: Scrap Reaper
description: Videogame made in 14 day GameJam using Godot. Rip cars apart, sort the parts and don't let your time run out!

title: Can't Tell You
description: Short narrative "heist gone wrong" game made in 50h oiSIDE GameJam heavily inspired by the great Thirty Flights of Loving.

title: Your Form... Incomplorbed
description: A game made in 48h Matfyz GameJam about alien bureaucratic nightmare for human immigrants. It won the special "Please, Fix This!" Best Game Award.

title: Secret Munchies
description: You play as a spy at a Pentagon fast-food joint called Secret Munchies. You must prep food, eavesdrop on top-secret conversations and send the intel back to HQ via Morse code.

title: Journey of the Prairie King
description: Semestral project recreating minigame from Stardew Valley using Javascript, CSS and HTML.

title: South Park
description: Recreation of South Park’s "Good Times with Weapons" Scene. I created custom rigs and hand animated frame by frame.
